scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const p1 = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'backend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const p2 = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'frontend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { p1.kill(); p2.kill(); process.exit(); });"
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend run test:run && npm --prefix backend test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run lint
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
